messages.message:
Patch Set 5:

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good; one optional (minor) point for whenever this is next refreshed, no need to re-spin for it.

(minor) The subject says osc and obdclass are converted, but two obdclass files still spell the compat path on the current base:

    lustre/obdclass/lu_tgt_alloc.c: #include <lustre_compat/linux/timer.h>
    lustre/obdclass/hash.c:         #include <lustre_compat/linux/workqueue.h>

Both arrived in master after the first version of this patch was written (LU-8933 aa26e45f67 and LU-21099 8740186a76). Both wrappers already use include_next, so <linux/timer.h> and <linux/workqueue.h> would work the same way here. Should they be included so obdclass is fully converted, or left for a follow-up sweep?

commit.message:
LU-18687 build: use native header names in osc, obdclass

The lustre_compat wrappers now shadow the kernel headers they
extend, so include them by the kernel header name.
